verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Person Tracking, which records which users are affected by each error. This works automatically in Rails and Django and needs SDK configuration elsewhere, so user impact per item is a first-party capability. The pack never shows per-issue session counts, though; the 'sessions' references are pricing quotas and a beta Session Replay feature, not impact metrics. It also never shows that items can be sorted or prioritized by affected users rather than occurrence counts. missing for 10: per-issue affected-session counts, documented sorting/prioritization of items by affected users, independent or hands-on corroboration of the impact metrics.
